Did you know?

page.overview:
What is Cerulean Guard?

The Cerulean Guard is a Loyalist Chapter of Space Marines of unknown Founding and origin who fought to defend the Fortress World of Cadia during the climax of the 13th Black Crusade in 999.M41.

The Cerulean Guard's Chapter colours are currently unrecorded in Imperial records.

The Cerulean Guard's Chapter badge is currently unrecorded in Imperial records.
